title: Choose the dull light-mode direction
question: Overcast Ash & Mineral is the roll's assigned direction for both frontends. Keep it, choose an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Overcast Ash & Mineral
options.lineage: Acoustic studio felt, unglazed ceramic, stamped parcel labels
options.thesis: A zero-glare matte ash and ceramic workspace that reserves color strictly for live detections, the occupancy line, and active alerts.
options.viewport: Quiet 48px header with port link, one hairline-divided metrics strip, underline tabs, and a 60/40 live frame and telemetry split.
options.risk: Can feel overly quiet if active alert banners and 1px hairline boundaries lack clear separation.

raised.raise: Chrome stays strictly neutral greyscale so the single teal data hue registers at under 2% of pixels.
Saturated color is quarantined inside the live CV frame and active anomaly badges.
Tables and triggers use fixed tabular alignment and persistent muted alert indicators until cleared.

options.label: Matte Stone Ledger
options.lineage: Swiss architectural rag paper and museum conservation logs
options.thesis: Warm dull stone ground with muted chalk panels, charcoal ink, and one slate-blue telemetry line.
options.viewport: Centered stone workspace with a unified 6-value telemetry ledger, underline tabs, and clean stream/log columns.
options.risk: Familiar developer-ledger silhouette; low surprise in exchange for maximum calm.

options.label: Gate Board & Dispatch Pass
options.lineage: Transit departure boards and segmented dispatch slips
options.thesis: A segmented rule-status pass above a fixed-column live detection board that lights changed triggers in place.
options.viewport: Segmented status strip over the live frame and a dense fixed-column trigger board.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for tracking live R1/R2/R3 state changes; loses narrowly on eye comfort where segmented blocks feel busier than matte ash.
options.risk: Frequent rule transitions can feel busy if row highlights compete with the live video feed.

options.label: Monochrome Product Proof
options.thesis: Alternating claim-and-proof bands on near-white with one restrained accent.
options.viewport: Scrolling claim-and-proof layout instead of a live operational console.
options.case: Loses on both axes: Persuade marketing rhythm hides live telemetry, video, and controls.
options.kept: Near-achromatic chrome discipline with color reserved strictly for key points.
options.risk: Unusable as an operational monitoring tool.

options.label: Shoulder & Plate Lexicon
options.thesis: Tight serif columns with shoulder guide words and seven-ink bordered plates.
options.viewport: Reference lexicon spread with marginalia shoulder.
options.case: Loses on both axes: dense serif book columns add friction to live CV monitoring and sliders.
options.kept: Quarantining vivid color strictly inside the live media plate.
options.risk: Reads like a book costume over operational controls.

options.label: Full-Bleed Snap Feed
options.thesis: One full-screen video viewport with floating right-edge glyph controls.
options.viewport: Edge-to-edge video snap occupying 100% of the screen.
options.case: Loses on both axes: hides metrics, timelines, event tables, and encoder controls.
options.kept: Keeping the live video stream immediately visible on first load.
options.risk: Makes multi-metric telemetry and log inspection impossible.

options.label: Catalog Pulse Sleeve
options.thesis: Matte black sleeve with white pulsar lines and color-coded label strips.
options.viewport: Dark ground dominated by a single stacked waveform.
options.case: Loses on both axes: dark theme and encoded color blocks contradict the dull light mode and simplicity brief.
options.kept: Clean decoding of rule state labels without visual clutter.
options.risk: Violates the user's explicit light-mode and simplicity requirements.

options.label: Variable Type Specimen
options.thesis: Oversized display typography morphing live with range sliders.
options.viewport: Giant specimen header above a glyph grid.
options.case: Loses on both axes: giant display lettering crowds out video, charts, and tables.
options.kept: Instant, responsive live readout updates when encoder sliders move.
options.risk: Zero utility for camera monitoring or anomaly inspection.

canonCard.label: Standard Light Operations UI
canonCard.thesis: Conventional bright white cards over cool light gray with blue primary controls.
canonCard.viewport: Standard top bar, KPI card row, video monitor, and tables.
canonCard.risk: Bright #FFFFFF surfaces cause more eye glare than a dull matte light palette.
